nodes.label: Flow 7: Booking Widget Setup (with 10-min hold countdown)
Decision: SSE over polling for real-time updates
Decision: Exponential backoff (1s..30s) for SSE reconnect
Decision: Last-Event-ID for at-least-once delivery + client dedupe
Decision: 5-minute hold TTL at API layer
Decision: Booking widget surfaces 10-min hold countdown to guest
Decision: Optimistic UI updates with revert-on-failure
Decision: No global store; React hooks + per-page state
Decision: Use callback refs for SSE handlers (avoid reconnect on render)
Decision: Auth0 ROPC for E2E (skip browser login flow)
Decision: Auth0 JWT verification via @mbe/auth plugin (preHandler requireAuth)
Convention: Memoized API client + useCallback fetch + Promise.all
Convention: Rialto components only (no raw HTML primitives)
Convention: var(--rialto-*) tokens, no hardcoded colors, logical CSS props
Convention: ES module imports require .js extension
Convention: Error envelope { error, message, statusCode, details }
Convention: Domain error codes (HOLD_EXPIRED, OUTSIDE_HOURS, etc.)
